rows.label: Who pays withholding tax on employment income
rows.value: Foreign employees resident in Switzerland without a settlement permit (C), unless married to a Swiss citizen or C-permit holder (DBG art. 83), and employees living abroad on pay for work in Switzerland, such as cross-border commuters (art. 91)

rows.label: How it is collected
rows.value: The employer deducts the tax from the gross pay and pays it to the cantonal tax authority; it covers the federal, cantonal and communal income tax, including church tax where due

sections.title: Contractors: employment status (AHV) and withholding on fees

rows.label: Official test: employee or self-employed
rows.value: For AHV purposes, self-employed means working in one's own name and on one's own account, independently, and bearing one's own business risk; someone without a specific business risk who depends economically or organisationally on an employer is an employee. The economic facts count, not the contract

rows.label: Signs of business risk (WML)
rows.value: Significant investments, bearing losses, collection and credit risk, bearing costs; also acting under a business name, own premises, several clients and staff of one's own (AHV leaflet 2.02)

rows.label: Who decides
rows.value: The AHV compensation fund (Ausgleichskasse), case by case and for each activity; the same person can be self-employed for one activity and employed for another

rows.label: Official guidance
rows.value: BSV Wegleitung über den massgebenden Lohn (WML), chapter 2.4; AHV leaflet 2.02; the federal portal selbststaendig-erwerbend.ch

rows.label: Freelancers and agents
rows.value: Count as employees in principle (AHV leaflet 2.02), so the client deducts AHV/IV/EO and ALV contributions

rows.label: Withholding on payments to resident contractors
rows.value: None: self-employed residents pay income tax and their AHV contributions by assessment

rows.label: Non-resident artists, athletes and speakers (DBG art. 92)
rows.value: Federal withholding on daily income after a flat cost deduction (50% for artists, 20% for athletes and speakers): 0.8% up to CHF 200, 2.4% up to CHF 1,000, 5% up to CHF 3,000, 7% above CHF 3,000; cantonal withholding on top

source.title: Fedlex: Bundesgesetz über die direkte Bundessteuer (DBG, SR 642.11), Stand am 2. September 2026, Art. 92-94

rows.label: Non-resident board members of Swiss companies: federal withholding on fees and similar pay (DBG art. 93)

source.title: Fedlex: Bundesgesetz über die direkte Bundessteuer (DBG, SR 642.11), Stand am 2. September 2026, Art. 92-94

rows.label: Non-resident mortgage creditors: federal withholding on interest from Swiss real-estate-secured loans (DBG art. 94)

source.title: Fedlex: Bundesgesetz über die direkte Bundessteuer (DBG, SR 642.11), Stand am 2. September 2026, Art. 92-94

sections.note: Cantons add their own withholding to the federal rates for non-resident artists, board members and creditors (each canton's rate differs).

rows.label: Simplified or flat-rate income tax for the self-employed
rows.value: None: business income is taxed with the ordinary federal tariff (Art. 36 DBG) and the canton's tariff

VAT net tax rate method (Saldosteuersatzmethode): annual taxable turnover up to
Net tax rate method: VAT due per year, at the business's net tax rate, up to
Net tax rate method: how it works

rows.note: 0.5% federal, 4.5% cantonal and communal; collected with the social contributions by the AHV compensation fund

rows.value: Not a regime for businesses: available only to foreign nationals who do not work in Switzerland (see the freelancers section)

sections.note: The VAT figures apply since 1 January 2024 (MWSTG art. 37) and are confirmed for 2026 by the ESTV overview of taxes in force.

sections.title: Corporate tax: federal, cantonal and communal profit tax

rows.label: Direct federal tax on the net profit of companies and cooperatives (DBG art. 68)
Tax as an expense
rows.value: Federal, cantonal and communal taxes are deductible business expenses (DBG art. 59), so the effective federal rate on profit before tax is lower than 8.5%

rows.label: Associations, foundations and other legal entities (DBG art. 71)
Associations, foundations and other legal entities: profit below this is not taxed
Capital tax
rows.value: None at federal level; every canton taxes the equity of companies

rows.label: Participation deduction
rows.value: Tax on profit is reduced in proportion to net income from participations of at least 10% or worth at least CHF 1,000,000

rows.label: Cantonal and communal profit tax
rows.value: Set by each canton: a proportional rate in 21 cantons and a mixed system with several rates in BE, SH, VD, VS and NE, usually multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers; each canton's 2026 rate and multipliers are on its canton page

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.5 Gewinn- und Kapitalsteuern juristischer Personen

rows.label: Minimum taxes of the cantons
rows.value: Some cantons levy a minimum tax on substitute factors (usually real estate) or a fixed minimum amount of CHF 50 to 500 a year; the Confederation, ZH, BE, GL, NE, GE and JU levy neither

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.5 Gewinn- und Kapitalsteuern juristischer Personen

rows.label: Official list of cantonal rates
rows.value: ESTV Steuermäppchen 'Gewinnsteuer: einfache Ansätze und jährliches Vielfaches' and the ESTV Kantonsblätter (https://www.estv.admin.ch/de/steuermaeppchen)

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.5 Gewinn- und Kapitalsteuern juristischer Personen

Fedlex: Bundesgesetz über die direkte Bundessteuer (DBG, SR 642.11), Stand am 2. September 2026, Art. 59, 68, 69 and 71; ESTV Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 2.1.1.2

sections.note: The federal rate applies to the profit after tax; cantons tax the same profit with their own rates and multipliers. The tax year is the company's business year.

sections.title: Corporate tax: OECD minimum tax (Ergänzungssteuer)

rows.label: Who is covered
rows.value: Multinational groups with consolidated annual revenue of at least EUR 750,000,000; other companies are not affected

rows.label: Swiss top-up tax (QDMTT)
rows.value: Levied since 1 January 2024 on Swiss group entities whose effective rate is below 15%

rows.label: International top-up tax (IIR)
rows.value: In force since 1 January 2025 on low-taxed foreign group entities of Swiss-parented groups

rows.label: Undertaxed payments rule (UTPR)
rows.value: Not in force: the Federal Council has decided not to bring it into force for the time being

rows.label: Legal basis
rows.value: Federal Council ordinance on the minimum taxation of large corporate groups (MindStV) of 22 December 2023, based on Art. 197 no. 15 of the Federal Constitution; a federal act must replace it within six years. Assessed and collected by the cantons

source.title: ESTV: Ergänzungssteuer; ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Besteuerung der juristischen Personen (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, April 2026); Verordnung über die Mindestbesteuerung grosser Unternehmensgruppen (MindStV) vom 22. Dezember 2023

sections.title: Branch profits and distributed profits

rows.label: Branches of foreign companies
rows.value: Pay federal profit tax at the same 8.5% rate and cantonal profit tax on the profit of the Swiss permanent establishment (limited tax liability, DBG art. 51); no separate branch profits tax

rows.label: Withholding tax (Verrechnungssteuer) on dividends and interest from Swiss companies, banks and bonds
rows.note: withheld by the Swiss payer; levied only where the payer is domestic

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 2.2.2 Verrechnungssteuer

rows.label: Withholding tax on life annuities and pensions

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 2.2.2 Verrechnungssteuer

rows.label: Withholding tax on other insurance benefits

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 2.2.2 Verrechnungssteuer

rows.label: Refund
rows.value: Swiss residents who declare the income get the tax back or credited; non-residents may claim a full or partial refund under a tax treaty

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 2.2.2 Verrechnungssteuer

Fedlex: Bundesgesetz über die direkte Bundessteuer (DBG, SR 642.11), Stand am 2. September 2026, Art. 51 and 68; ESTV Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), sections 2.1.1.2 and 2.2.2

sections.note: Profit sent from a Swiss branch to its foreign head office is not a dividend from a domestic payer, so no withholding tax arises; a Swiss subsidiary's dividends bear the 35% withholding tax.

sections.title: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer and the imputed rental value reform

rows.label: Federal level
rows.value: None: the Confederation levies no property tax and the tax harmonisation act has no rules on it

rows.label: Who levies it
rows.value: Mainly municipalities: in every municipality of SG, TI, VS and JU; optionally in BE, OW, FR, AI, GR and VD; the canton only in TG and GE; TI and VS also tax legal entities' real estate at cantonal level; NE taxes investment property

rows.label: Base
rows.value: The gross value of the real estate (market, income or cadastral value), without deducting debts; levied where the property lies

rows.label: Rate range
rows.value: Proportional, from 0.1 per mille to 3 per mille of the property value

rows.label: Cantons without a property tax
rows.value: ZH, SZ, GL, ZG, SO, BL and AG; several cantons (LU, OW, NW, BS, SH, AR, TG, TI) levy a minimum tax on legal entities' real estate instead of profit and capital tax where it is higher

rows.label: Each canton's rules
rows.value: On the canton pages; ESTV Steuermäppchen 'Liegenschaftssteuer' (https://www.estv2.admin.ch/stp/sm/liegenschaftssteuern-de-fr.pdf)

rows.label: Imputed rental value (Eigenmietwert)
rows.value: Still taxed in 2026: owner-occupiers add the imputed rent of their home to taxable income and may deduct maintenance costs and debt interest

source.title: Der Bundesrat: Bundesrat setzt Abschaffung des Eigenmietwerts auf 2029 in Kraft (press release, 1 April 2026); ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Besteuerung der Eigenmietwerte (2026)

rows.label: Imputed rental value reform: vote
rows.value: Approved by the people on 28 September 2025 (57.7% yes): the constitutional amendment on cantonal property taxes on second homes, linked to the federal act on the change of system

source.title: Der Bundesrat: Bundesrat setzt Abschaffung des Eigenmietwerts auf 2029 in Kraft (press release, 1 April 2026); ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Besteuerung der Eigenmietwerte (2026)

rows.label: Imputed rental value reform: start date
rows.value: Decided, not yet in force: the Federal Council set the entry into force for 1 January 2029 (decision of 1 April 2026); from then imputed rent on owner-occupied homes is no longer taxed, the maintenance-cost deduction for them ends, debt interest is deductible only in proportion to let property, and cantons may levy a special property tax on mainly owner-used second homes

source.title: Der Bundesrat: Bundesrat setzt Abschaffung des Eigenmietwerts auf 2029 in Kraft (press release, 1 April 2026); ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Besteuerung der Eigenmietwerte (2026)
ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.11 Liegenschaftssteuer

sections.note: The property tax is separate from the cantonal wealth tax (which allows debts to be deducted) and from the property gains tax on sales.

sections.title: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer

rows.label: Federal level
rows.value: None: transfer taxes are cantonal or communal

rows.label: Who levies it
rows.value: Usually the canton; a municipal tax in AR, SG and GR; in FR, VD and VS the municipalities can add their own

rows.label: Cantons with no transfer tax as such
rows.value: ZH, UR, SZ, GL, ZG, SH, AG and TI charge only land registry or transfer fees

rows.label: Base and payer
rows.value: Usually the purchase price; paid by the buyer unless agreed otherwise; in OW, BL and AR buyer and seller usually pay half each

rows.label: Rate range
rows.value: Usually a fixed rate between 1% and 3.3% of the purchase price

rows.label: Rates stored on the canton pages
rows.value: From 1% to 3% in the cantons whose current law was read; Graubünden, Neuchâtel, Geneva and Jura are awaiting a re-read

rows.label: Foreign buyers
rows.value: No transfer-tax surcharge; purchases of Swiss real estate by persons abroad need a permit under the federal Lex Koller (not a tax)

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.12 Handänderungssteuer

sections.note: Reliefs exist in some cantons for family transfers, main residences and business restructurings (see the canton pages).

sections.title: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property

rows.label: Corporate tax (Gewinnsteuer) [federal, cantonal and communal]
rows.value: federal 8.5% of net profit (4.25% for associations and foundations); cantonal and communal profit tax set by each canton; 15% OECD minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least EUR 750,000,000 (QDMTT since 2024, IIR since 2025). Paid by companies, cooperatives and other legal entities with seat, management or a permanent establishment in Switzerland. DBG art. 68 and 71; cantonal tax laws; MindStV of 22 December 2023.

source.title: Fedlex: Bundesgesetz über die direkte Bundessteuer (DBG, SR 642.11), Stand am 2. September 2026, Art. 59, 68, 69 and 71; ESTV Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 2.1.1.2

rows.label: Tax on branch profits and distributed profits [federal]
rows.value: branch profits: profit tax at the normal rates, no separate branch tax; dividends and interest: 35% withholding tax (Verrechnungssteuer). Paid by the Swiss payer withholds it from the shareholder or creditor. DBG art. 51; Bundesgesetz über die Verrechnungssteuer (VStG).

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 2.2.2 Verrechnungssteuer

rows.label: Self-employed contributions: AHV/IV/EO [federal]
rows.value: 10% of earned income from CHF 60,500, sliding scale from 5.371% below that, minimum CHF 530 a year, no ceiling; plus up to 5% administrative costs and the cantonal family-allowance contribution. Paid by self-employed people (through their AHV compensation fund). AHVG; IVG; EOG; AHV leaflet 2.02.

source.title: Informationsstelle AHV/IV: Merkblatt 2.02 Beiträge der Selbstständigerwerbenden an die AHV, die IV und die EO (Stand am 1. Januar 2026)

rows.label: Contractor or employee: AHV status test [federal]
rows.value: the AHV compensation fund decides on the economic facts (own business risk, independence); no withholding on payments to resident contractors; federal withholding on fees to non-resident artists, athletes and speakers (0.8% to 7%) and board members (5%). Paid by clients who engage workers (AHV contributions where the work is employment). AHVG art. 5 and 9; BSV Wegleitung über den massgebenden Lohn; DBG art. 92 and 93.

source.title: Informationsstelle AHV/IV: Merkblatt 2.02 (Stand am 1. Januar 2026); BSV: Wegleitung über den massgebenden Lohn in der AHV, IV und EO (WML), Stand 1. Mai 2026, Rz 1013-1019

rows.label: Simplified regimes: VAT net tax rate method and simplified settlement [federal]
rows.value: no simplified income tax; VAT registration from CHF 100,000 turnover; net tax rate method up to CHF 5,024,000 turnover and CHF 108,000 VAT a year; 5% flat tax in the simplified settlement procedure for small wages. Paid by businesses that opt in. MWSTG art. 10 and 37; DBG art. 37a; Bundesgesetz gegen die Schwarzarbeit (BGSA).

source.title: Fedlex: Mehrwertsteuergesetz (MWSTG, SR 641.20), Stand am 1. Januar 2024, Art. 37; ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 2.2.1

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (Quellensteuer) [federal, cantonal and communal]
rows.value: withheld by the employer at the canton's tariff; ordinary assessment on request for quasi-residents (at least 90% of worldwide income taxed in Switzerland); German commuters at most 4.5%; Italian new commuters 80% of the tariff. Paid by non-resident employees and foreign residents without a C permit (withheld by the employer). DBG art. 83-101; QStV; StHG art. 32-38; tax treaties and cross-border agreements.

source.title: Fedlex: Bundesgesetz über die direkte Bundessteuer (DBG, SR 642.11), Stand am 2. September 2026, Art. 83, 91 and 99a; Fedlex: Quellensteuerverordnung des EFD (QStV, SR 642.118.2), Stand am 10. Januar 2025, Art. 1 and 14

rows.label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer) [cantonal or communal]
rows.value: in about half the cantons, mostly communal, 0.1 per mille to 3 per mille of the gross property value; none in ZH, SZ, GL, ZG, SO, BL and AG; imputed rental value abolished from 1 January 2029 (vote of 28 September 2025). Paid by property owners. cantonal tax laws and municipal tax regulations.

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.11 Liegenschaftssteuer

rows.label: Property transfer tax (Handänderungssteuer) [cantonal or communal]
rows.value: usually 1% to 3.3% of the purchase price; none as such in ZH, UR, SZ, GL, ZG, SH, AG and TI (fees only). Paid by the buyer unless agreed otherwise (half each in OW, BL and AR). cantonal transfer tax laws.

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.12 Handänderungssteuer

Fedlex: Bundesgesetz über die direkte Bundessteuer (DBG, SR 642.11), Stand am 2. September 2026, Art. 59, 68, 69 and 71; ESTV Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 2.1.1.2

sections.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
